title: Assessing the Effects of Omega-3 Supplementation on Some Serum BDNF، Follistatin، Irisin Levels in Men With CAD

sections.abstract: The aim of this study is the comparison between the effects of supplementation with omega 3 or placebo for 8 weeks in serum level of BDNF، Follistatin، Irisin in patients with cardiovascular disease.
